slides.text: Stop setting goals. Set these instead.
Goals describe an outcome. Outcomes depend on things you do not control.
Set an input instead: the action you can repeat no matter what happens.
Instead of "lose weight", choose "walk for 20 minutes after dinner".
Define a minimum version for bad days. Five minutes counts.
Review weekly, not daily. Ask what got in the way and remove one obstacle.
Outcomes are the scoreboard. Inputs are the game.
Save this and rewrite one goal as an input today.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily
